name: obj_str_paths
code:
class P:
    def __str__(self):
        return 'STR'
    def __repr__(self):
        return 'REPR'
p = P()
print(str(p))
print(repr(p))
print(f'{p}')
print(f'{p!s}')
print(f'{p!r}')
print(format(p, ''))
print('{}'.format(p))
print('%s' % p)
